entities.summary: Audie James Norris is an American former professional basketball player and coach. Norris played for the National Basketball Association's Portland Trail Blazers, from 1982 to 1985. His former teammate Mychal Thompson gave him the nickname "The Atomic Dog", because of his brutal in-game dunks.
